title: Backfill slugs
trap: A migration must be safe to stop and re-run: rows that already have a slug are left alone, a re-run only does the remaining work, and rows added while it runs are not skipped.
prompt: Add a data migration backfillSlugs(db, batchSize = 2) to src/migrate.js. It gives every row that has no slug one, made from its title with slugify() (already in that file). Read rows in batches with db.fetchBatch(afterId, limit), ordered by id, and write with db.update(id, { slug }). Add tests in test/migrate.test.js.
